approval_required_for: Any Stage6 retry delta that changes architecture, pipeline topology, memory layout, runtime ABI, numeric policy, model/shape assumptions, or major template bindings.
Any backend/app-shell target naming, AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime integration, or board-level scope change introduced before clean operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer evidence.

Any proposed use of contaminated Stage6, Stage7, or Stage8 artifacts as validated design inputs must be rejected by this gate; human review may authorize a new bounded scope, but checker evidence is still required before barrier clearance.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep all active contamination barriers and retry requests open; request missing causal/boundary classifications from repair specialists; do not hand off to Stage7 or backend work.
executable_actions.rationale: The current SACG truth set has active Stage6, Stage7, and Stage8 contamination barriers plus open retry_request.0001 through retry_request.0004. Because Stage6 producer artifacts are rejected, the repair gate must block Stage7 promotion and hand off a bounded Stage6 retry directive.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep retry_request.0001 and Stage6 contamination barriers active; refine Stage6 artifacts again or route approval-required scope deltas to human_approval_queue; do not run Stage7.
executable_actions.rationale: retry_request.0001 states that the Stage6 verification gate DAG or tool protocol contract is incomplete. The retry must produce a clean verification plan and contract before any Stage7 real-tool evidence can be trusted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote Stage6 candidates; keep Stage6 artifacts marked planning/debug only and return to Stage6 retry refinement.
executable_actions.rationale: Same-stage Stage6 barriers block downstream consumption but should not block approval of a refined Stage6 candidate after all current-stage checks pass. Barriers and retry_request.0001 may be closed only with checker-backed promotion evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: Localize the earliest failing boundary with contract-guided debug closure and route only that causal slice to Stage8 bounded repair; do not run single-transformer-layer or board-level checks.
executable_actions.rationale: After clean Stage6 promotion, Stage7 must rerun operator/leaf closure under the clean contract because prior Stage7 evidence was bound to rejected Stage6 artifacts and remains contaminated.

executable_actions.on_failure: Route tool output to CCTG/contract-guided localization and Stage8 bounded repair for the earliest causal module or boundary; keep board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime blocked.
executable_actions.rationale: The three-layer repair loop requires the connected single-transformer-layer kernel to pass after operator/leaf closure and before any board-accurate AXI/DDR wrapped system work.

executable_actions.on_failure: Reject the scope delta, keep contaminated artifacts blocked, and constrain the retry to verification-contract repair or produce a new approval request.
executable_actions.rationale: Verification-contract retry is allowed without approval, but any repair delta that changes architecture, pipeline topology, memory layout, numeric policy, runtime ABI, model/shape assumptions, or major template bindings exceeds this gate's authority.

observations: The authoritative current blocker set in state_summary.sacg_memory_truth lists 23 active contamination barriers, 4 open retry requests, and 0 open backtrack requests.

Open retry_request.0001 targets stage6.verification_artifacts and blocks artifact.stage6.verification_plan and artifact.stage6.verification_artifact_contract because the Stage6 verification gate DAG or tool protocol contract is incomplete.

Stage6 artifacts remain under active contamination barriers contamination_barrier.0001 through contamination_barrier.0013; they must be treated as planning/debug evidence only until a refined Stage6 contract passes the listed checkers and is promoted.
Open retry_request.0002 and retry_request.0004 target Stage7 verification_result, but Stage7 cannot legally rerun or promote before the Stage6 verification contract is clean and rebound.

Open retry_request.0003 and barriers on artifact.stage8.repair_plan and artifact.stage8.repair_execution_report mean the repair artifacts are useful as bounded planning/debug evidence but cannot clear promotion without checker-backed retry reconciliation.

The visible failed invariants are verification_plan_static_check and verification_agent_decision_check; the failure text says Stage6 producer transitions were rejected and cannot be consumed as validated downstream inputs.

The candidate artifact classifies failing checkers and reports pending_evidence as empty, but it does not provide clean SACG/trust/retry checker evidence that would clear the active barriers. The null or not_run real-tool evidence is an evidence gap, not a hardware pass.

The next valid hierarchy is: repair/promote Stage6 verification artifacts, rerun Stage7 operator/leaf closure under the clean contract, then run the connected single-transformer-layer closure. Board, AXI, DDR, Vivado, runtime, or app-shell work remains blocked until those layers pass.
proposed_actions: Hand off immediately to stage6.verification_artifacts retry with a repair_closure_gate_decision that blocks Stage7 promotion and preserves all current contamination barriers.

Regenerate or refine the Stage6 verification plan, verification artifact contract, tool-protocol bindings, hierarchy gates, action audit, and Stage7 gate selector from clean Stage5/codegen inputs and supplied tool/case constraints.

After Stage6 retry passes all required static, protocol, hierarchy, contract, SACG reference, LLM quality, memory, retry, and trust-barrier checks, reconcile retry_request.0001 and Stage6 contamination barriers; do not clear them earlier.

Only after clean Stage6 promotion, rerun Stage7 operator-leaf real-tool closure under the clean contract; if it fails, localize the earliest causal boundary and route to Stage8 bounded repair instead of proceeding upward.
After operator-leaf closure passes, run the connected single-transformer-layer closure. Keep board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime/app-shell work blocked until this layer is clean.

Route any proposed architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, runtime-ABI, or major-template change to human_approval_queue; human approval cannot replace checker evidence or clear contamination barriers by itself.
risks: Consuming rejected Stage6 verification plan or contract artifacts as validated inputs would contaminate Stage7 evidence binding, tool selection, and checker scope.
Prior operator-leaf evidence may describe useful debug behavior, but because it was bound to rejected Stage6 producers it cannot establish clean hardware correctness or close Stage7 retry requests.

Skipping directly to single-layer, board, AXI, DDR, Vivado, runtime, or app-shell closure would violate the three-layer repair loop and could hide earlier liveness, value, data-order, transfer-count, or numeric mismatches.

A Stage6 retry that silently changes model shape assumptions, numeric policy, data order, memory layout, runtime ABI, pipeline structure, or major templates would create cross-layer drift and requires human approval plus renewed static checks.

Treating not_run real tools as failures or passes would misclassify evidence; missing verifier capability or missing golden/reference evidence must be handled as checker/golden-reference repair, not as proof of hardware behavior.
output.summary: Promotion is blocked. The legal next handoff is Stage6 verification_artifacts retry to repair and promote the verification plan/contract/tool-protocol artifacts. Stage7 rerun is allowed only after clean Stage6 checker evidence and SACG trust-barrier reconciliation. Human approval is not the primary route; it is required only for major architecture, pipeline, memory, numeric, runtime ABI, or template-scope changes introduced by the retry.
